title: The Third Vaccine, and Vaccine Choice
summary:
If the main concern is trying to ensure that you
don't suffer from severe disease or risk death, from the data we have today, all three vaccines,
well, not perfect, seem to be effective. If the virus is circulating broadly broadly, the greatest risk
you have is being infected by the virus.
